usage: conv_linker_config [-h] {proto,print,systemprovide,append,merge} ...

positional arguments:
  {proto,print,systemprovide,append,merge}
    proto               Convert the input JSON configuration file into
                        protobuf.
    print               Print configuration in human-readable text format.
    systemprovide       Append system provide libraries into the
                        configuration.
    append              Append value(s) to given key.
    merge               Merge configurations
